links.comparator_used: Original Chinese-cohort predictive model applied as-is (without local adaptation) to the French cohort
links.outcome: Risk stratification of patients at risk of TKI therapy failure in the French CP-CML cohort
links.effect: The original model did not discriminate risk groups effectively in the French cohort; the model rebuilt on the French cohort identified other predictive variables (sex, leukocytosis, comorbidities, high-risk additional chromosomal abnormalities) that better stratified patients. No numeric metrics reported in the text.
links.quote: However, the model reconstruction using this cohort identified other predictive variables (sex, leukocytosis, comorbidities, high-risk additional chromosomal abnormalities) that better stratified patients at risk of therapy failure.

design_hint: local validation and recalibration of predictive model before use
